bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; canceling a portion of an appropriation for the Stone Arch Bridge in the city of Minneapolis.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION CANCELLATION; STONE ARCH BRIDGE.

The uncommitted balance of the appropriation in fiscal year 2024 under Laws 2023, chapter 68, article 1, section 2, subdivision 2, paragraph (e), for the Stone Arch Bridge in the city of Minneapolis, estimated to be $19,337, is canceled to the general fund on the effective date of this section.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective June 30, 2025.
